Description

inManage, a software development company, specializing in sophisticated e-commerce solutions, is looking for a motivated, talented and skillful Junior React Developer to join our growing team. Among our customers are huge brands such as McDonald's, Grow (Meshulam), Domino's Pizza, Carrefour, Leaan, Aroma Israel,Machsanei Hashmal, Shlomo Group, NewDeli and more.

This is a great opportunity to show your talent, work with amazing people, advanced technologies and big customers.

Requirements

  • B.Sc in computer science or related field - must.
  • Knowledge of Javascript, Reactjs, CSS, HTML – must.
  • Knowledge of React Native - an advantage.
  • Understanding of design patterns.
  • Knowledge of RESTful api, Web services, JSON.

* Personal Projects would be considered as experience.
